importantInfo.title: LIVE: Google Review Game
importantInfo.body:
Starting Monday we will be running a google review competition to help increase our digital visibility! AI is pulling info from these reviews to help recommend us, so if we can capture even more reviews, its a win-win all around. 
Some key things to have your patients mention in their reviews:
Which location,
who they saw (including if they were a PT, OT, DC)
what treatments they received 
what they came in for/how its improving

Each front desk should have a flyer posted with QR codes that take patients directly to the Google review option for your location. 
Each clinic should have small business cards with QR codes on them you can directly hand to the patients!

importantInfo.title: IMPORTANT: Labor Day
importantInfo.body: Labor Day is right around the corner. Per the handbook, everyone is given 8 hours of holiday PTO. If anyone works more than 8 hours on the Monday of Labor Day, they are to move clinic hours to somewhere else in the week. Everyone that this applies to can choose where the hours are moved to, but we are 1 week out so please discuss your plan with your CD as soon as possible !

importantInfo.title: IMPORTANT: 2 appointments in one day
importantInfo.body: Moving forward, our patients are no longer able to use their insurance for 2 visits on the same day. It doesn't matter if the patient is seeing providers of different license types or getting treated for different body parts. Kim is having a hard time getting insurance to pay for either visit when this happens, so if a patient needs 2 appointments in one day, one visit must be self-pay.

importantInfo.title: POLICY CHANGE: Preserving Visit Counts during PTO
importantInfo.body:
Per Bridgette's email in your inbox:

We've heard your feedback around PTO and the impact that taking longer periods of time off can have on bonus eligibility. We listened to your concerns and have worked to come up with a solution that helps minimize that impact while still supporting you in taking the time off you need. 

Going forward, when you are out on PTO, visits will count towards your (and the provider who completes the visit) visit total if you successfully transition that patient onto another provider's schedule during your absence. This gives you the opportunity to maintain your and your clinic's visit numbers while also ensuring your patients continue receiving care while you are away.

Please check out the playbook in Bridgette's email for more details and eligibility on how to utilize this perk. 

As always, we as a leadership team appreciate everyone who provided feedback and are excited to share this solution and continue to make FIT better than before.

importantInfo.title: Process Change: ABN Charge
importantInfo.body:
ABN CHANGES GO INTO EFFECT THIS WEEK. 97139 is no longer an acceptable ABN code. If you do not bill one of the codes listed below, you must notate why in the checkout screen and on the physical paper your PCC hands you. If you have questions about the ABN, use the teams chat dedicated for ABN questions/discussion. After you've tried that, then you may ask Kim but please specify which patient you're talking about, the visit date, and the ABN code you have a question about.
IMPORTANT: For compliance reasons, please make sure you are adding the therapy that you are billing to the plan section of your SOAP note. 
Per the town hall that happened two weeks ago, we are changing the ABN code for all insurances that need an ABN (UHC, Cigna, Optum). If you did not attend the townhall, please see the recording on Teams.
Only acceptable ABN codes are:
20560 (Dry Needling 1-2 areas)
20561 (Dry Needling 3+ areas)
CUPTH (Cupping)

importantInfo.title: Process Change: NP Access Blocks
importantInfo.body: When scheduling New Patients in a NP Access Block, instead of sliding the existing NP Access Block to another timeslot, please create a new NP Access Block so we can better track the Fill Rate of these Access Blocks. If a NP Access Block does not get filled within 24 hours, you will still slide the Block to open up that timeslot to existing patients.
